tasks.title: Задача 1
tasks.statement: What can one see in the Moon's sky more often - the Sun or the Earth?

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 2
tasks.statement:
In a new postal service a huge cannon shots a postal shell from England to New
Zealand. Can you estimate the duration of the shells flight?

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 3
tasks.statement:
It is known that the equatorial coordinates of vernal equinox are 0 hr and 0 deg.
Which are the North ecliptic pole coordinates?

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 4
tasks.statement:
Suppose that the Sun collapsed suddenly to a black hole. How would the orbital
period of the Earth be affected?

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 5
tasks.statement:
Can we distinguish the lunar Mare Crisium, which diameter is 520 km, by a
naked eye?

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 6
tasks.statement:
There are about of 250 millions of stars in the elliptical galaxy M32 (a satellite
of Andromeda galaxy). The visual magnitude of this galaxy is 9m. If luminosities
of all stars are equal, what is the visual magnitude of one star in this galaxy?

Theoretical round
                       Group B (seniors, > 16 years old).

                                            Text of these problems is available also
                                     in Bulgarian, Danish, Portuguese and Russian.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
